Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Portable binary64 nonnegative real-weight summaries with separate population/reliability variance/covariance/stddev, positive-weight count, total weight, stable correction denominator, effective count, correlation and simple fit. Coordinates are validated even at zero weight; zero reports explicit no change. Borrowed equal-length batches are atomic and indexed. All three registered gates pass on Linux x86_64: the initial 13.07-second run covers 1,908 independent Fraction/220-digit Decimal cases, contracts and a separate CPU oracle-control test; the strengthened current contract rerun passes in 6.03 seconds with paired shape/count/late-y-overflow rollback and an empty memory syscall trace. The rerun replaces the older contract receipt. The current real CSV program passes four registered tests/66 cases. Both f64 backing forms are descending, with no positive packed-stride claim. No allocation or host math; manual backing lifetimes, finite-state/gradual-underflow limits and unclaimed broader accuracy, targets and formal proofs remain explicit.
